cohort: 36 patients diagnosed with placenta accreta or increta preoperatively and intraoperatively.
finding: Bakri balloon tamponade was associated with lower intraoperative blood loss, blood transfusion amount, and operation time compared to caesarean hysterectomy for the treatment of placenta accreta and increta.
mod_finding: This study compared Bakri balloon tamponade to hysterectomy for placenta accreta and increta, finding that balloon tamponade may be a preferable option for preserving fertility.
